The 40-F itself is a shell that incorporates the AIF, MD&A and audited consolidated F/S by reference; those exhibits were not fetched into the local cache and would normally hold the bulk of substantive narrative. The 6-Ks furnished during 2024-2026 are similarly thin shells that point at press releases. Claims below are therefore extracted from the press-release titles attached to 6-Ks (which are themselves the company's own promotional / disclosure language) plus the publicly indexed cohort/subject metadata (long history of OEM partnerships, etc.). The 40-F cover sheet confirms 299,438,116 common shares outstanding at 2024-12-31 and PFIC status for the most recently completed tax year (a tax-relevant tell of accumulated losses + cash-heavy balance sheet typical of pre-commercial issuers).
